question: What auspicious knowledge is now sought regarding the overcoming of time?
premises: The speaker expresses a wish to hear.
The desired teaching is the auspicious overcoming of time.
inference: The speaker now seeks the auspicious teaching on how to overcome time.
uncertainties: vañcanaṃ can mean deception or outwitting; context suggests overcoming.
